dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: *sigh* Seems like nobody can get to the bottom of it...

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: The clue! ...Hmm, perhaps "rumor" is a better word... a rumor about treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: There's an adventurer who said that he found a clue to treasure in the vicinity of Tianqiu Valley... But he tried everything, and simply could not locate the treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: In the end, he gave up looking and reported it to the Guild instead, and now the Guild is offering a reward for anyone able to solve this mysterious so-called "clue."

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Any adventurer who wants to give it a go can follow the clue and see where it takes them. If they solve the riddle and find the treasure, the Guild will offer a reward.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: But so far, nobody has found even a trace of the treasure...

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Oh, well, if you think you're up to it.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: If you really are interested, there's no harm in giving it a go.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: I'll mark the location mentioned in the clue on the map for you, then you can go take a look.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Well, like it says in the adventurer's code, finders keepers!

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: All the Guild wants out of it is experience in solving riddles like this. That is the most important thing for adventurers.
